lighthouseVersion.description: The version of Lighthouse with which these results were generated.

fetchTime.description: The ISO-8601 timestamp of when the results were generated.

userAgent.description: The user agent string of the version of Chrome that was used by Lighthouse.

requestedUrl.description: The URL that was supplied to Lighthouse and initially navigated to.

finalUrl.description: The URL that Lighthouse ended up auditing after redirects were followed.

score.description:
The overall score 0-100, a weighted average of all category scores.
NOTE: Only the PWA category has a weight by default

audits.description: An object containing the results of the audits.

configSettings.description: An object containing information about the configuration used by Lighthouse.

timing.description: An object containing information about how long Lighthouse spent auditing.

categories.description: An array containing the different categories, their scores, and the results of the audits that comprise them.

categoryGroups.description: An object containing the display groups of audits for the report.

stackPacks.description: An array of stack packs as found in the artifacts object.

title:
Lighthouse Results is the output of lighthouse, it contains some metadata about the run and the results in the various subproperties.
see https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/blob/master/docs/understanding-results.md
name: LighthouseResultObject
